subject: Evidence-lite safelist request for onboarding — EdgeLight Labs pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <procurement@edgelight.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only / no-PO path

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday — the team at EdgeLight Labs is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can accept invoices without a formal PO for the pilot period.

Quick background: our legal and procurement teams are swamped with an enterprise rollout next month; issuing a formal PO will take ~3 weeks. The pilot spend is expected to be ~$14k total. We can provide a signed SOW, W-9, and evidence of liability insurance.

Attached: edgelight_sow.pdf (SOW, PDF) and onboarding_form.csv (vendor intake fields).

Can you advise what limited evidence or controls Redwood needs to approve a temporary no-PO safelist so we can start billing immediately? If needed, we can route invoice approvals to a named approver at EdgeLight.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Senior Procurement Manager
EdgeLight Labs
procurement@edgelight.ai

---
Attachment stubs:
- edgelight_sow.pdf (application/pdf)
- onboarding_form.csv (text/csv)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <procurement@edgelight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only / no-PO path

Hi Aisha — welcome, and glad the demo was useful.

Short answer: we can usually support a temporary "evidence-lite" invoice-only route for small, time-bound pilots, but finance needs an approval ladder and a few controls in place. I've looped in Marissa (seller) and Marcus (finance) to confirm operational constraints.

Proposed minimums from our side:
- Signed SOW on file (received).
- Vendor W-9 and insurance certificate.
- Single invoice cap: $7,500; aggregate pilot cap: $15,000.
- Invoices must include a PO placeholder of "NO-PO-PILOT" and reference the HubSpot company id (EL-9876).
- Net 30 payment with standard Redwood invoice routing; vendor must send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai and cc procurement@edgelight.ai.
- Temporary approval valid for 6 weeks from start date; finance will re-evaluate for conversion to standard PO.

If Marcus confirms, I can convert this into a short internal approval email and add it to the vendor intake record. Marissa — please confirm commercial ok on the caps.

Naomi
Sr. Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only / no-PO path

Naomi / Marissa — reviewed the SOW and intake file. Finance can provisionally allow an invoice-only path with the following binding conditions: 

1) Aggregate pilot cap not to exceed $15,000 and individual invoice <= $7,500. Any single invoice above that must be paused until a PO is in place.
2) EdgeLight must supply W-9 and certificate of insurance (COI) before invoice payment.
3) Invoices must be PDF, reference "NO-PO-PILOT" and include the HubSpot company id (EL-9876) in the invoice body. Corrections will delay payment.
4) We will issue payments on Net30 once the above are met; no expedited ACH exceptions for pilots.
5) Finance will add EdgeLight to the shortlist (safelist) for 6 weeks; exceptions require approval from Treasury Director.

Operational ask for Marissa: confirm that the pilot commercial terms (trial discount, start date, and SOW scope) remain unchanged. Once Marissa confirms, I'll log the temporary approval and set controls in the AP system so invoices with the "NO-PO-PILOT" marker route to a named reviewer.

Marissa — please confirm and let us know the pilot start date so we can timestamp the 6-week window.

- Marcus
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Aisha — please send W-9 and COI to onboarding@redwood.ai and have future invoices sent to invoices@redwood.ai with the "NO-PO-PILOT" marker and EL-9876 in the body. We'll mark EdgeLight as a temporary safelist entry for 6 weeks starting May 3.
